Narrow the invariants or binding claims

open_points.subject: PLAT-REG-001 witness binding
open_points.text: PLAT-REG-001: the production `validate_project_reference`, answered over HTTP, refuses a UUID the Registry answers 404 or `exists=false` for an administrator, an operator, a viewer and both producer scopes, and in a viewer grant, an operator assignment and a producer grant, writing nothing; no service code generates a project id, the gateway only reads, and every project id the portal stores is one the Registry issued.
open_points.question: What verification can establish that every stored project_id was Registry-issued and that no portal path can create one, including seeded or indirectly generated values?
options: Use exhaustive construction and persistence-boundary checks
Define an authoritative issuance-evidence mechanism
Narrow the invariant to behavior the check can establish
open_points.default_guess: Use persistence-boundary checks requiring Registry validation for every stored project_id.

open_points.subject: INV-044 witness binding
open_points.text: INV-044: the budget derivation check: `calculate_material_balance` and the budget view show an overspent section as a negative remaining, a section without a progress record reads completion `None` and completed work value `None`, and a project without a budget reads its views as not configured [witness: verification:budget_derivation_client_portal].
open_points.question: What check will actually assert that completed_work_value is None when progress is absent?
options: Add an equality assertion for None to the named check
Bind another check that makes this assertion
Remove that claim from the binding
open_points.default_guess: Add an equality assertion for None to the named check.

open_points.subject: completed_work_total when all section progress is missing
open_points.text: `completed_work_total` (here and in `BudgetView`) is the sum of the sections' `completed_work_value` that are not `None`; a section without a progress record is left out of the sum, as it is left out of overall progress (A9).
open_points.question: When every section lacks a progress record, is completed_work_total the empty-sum value 0 or unavailable so that missing data is not represented as zero?
options: Return Decimal 0 as the empty sum
Make the total nullable/unavailable
Keep a numeric total but add a separate availability indicator
open_points.default_guess: Make the aggregate unavailable when it has no contributing recorded progress.

witness.initial: An active budget has one section with work_planned 1000.00 and no SectionProgress record.
events: A viewer reads BudgetView or ProgressView.
outcomes: The implementation sums no non-None values and returns completed_work_total = 0.00.
The implementation treats the aggregate as missing because no completed-work observation exists, following State 0's rule that missing data is never zeroed.
witness.observer: The viewer, and any work-balance calculation consuming the total.

open_points.subject: INV-026, INV-027 and INV-028 witness binding
open_points.text: INV-027: no table has a derived-value column, reading the views writes nothing, and after each change of an owning record (inclusion, allocations, progress, payment, plan) the next read equals a recomputation from the stored rows. INV-028: no service code deletes or replaces a portal section and no store surface removes one; activating a budget version without an allocated section is refused and writes nothing, and the activation keeps the sections progress references [witness: verification:budget_derivation_client_portal].

open_points.subject: activation refusal condition in INV-028 test
open_points.text: activating a budget version without an allocated section is refused and writes nothing
open_points.question: Does this mean activation is refused when the candidate version lacks a plan for any section targeted by an existing allocation, when the version has no allocated sections at all, or under some other condition?
options: Refuse when any existing allocation targets a section absent from the candidate version
Refuse every version containing no allocation-targeted section
Use another explicitly enumerated condition
open_points.default_guess: Refuse when any existing allocation targets a section absent from the candidate version.

witness.initial: A project has an expense allocated to section A; candidate budget version contains only section B.
events: An authorized staff member activates the candidate version.
outcomes: Activation is refused because allocation A would be unresolved.
Activation succeeds because the candidate does contain a section, even though it is not the allocated section.
witness.observer: The staff caller and subsequent budget/expense views.

open_points.subject: source-supplied timestamp input representation
open_points.text: their accepted forms and checks, and where in an operation its one clock read happens, are the accepted spec's, carried to States 6–7
open_points.question: Which source-supplied datetime forms are accepted, and how is each converted to the required offset-naive UTC storage representation without changing the instant?
options: Accept only offset-aware datetimes and normalize to UTC before dropping the offset
Accept only offset-naive UTC datetimes
Accept both with an explicit interpretation and normalization rule

events: The portal accepts and stores the snapshot.
outcomes: The portal stores 2026-11-08 12:00:00 after converting the instant to UTC and removing the offset.
The portal removes the offset without conversion and stores 2026-11-08 13:00:00.
witness.observer: Any later reader or comparison involving published_at.

open_points.subject: time-source delivery to operations
open_points.text: every other part of the portal obtains time from it and never reads a host clock itself
open_points.question: What concrete authority contract ensures operations receive the single time source: an explicit datetime parameter, an injected clock port, or a declared authority module?
options: Pass a captured datetime into each operation
Inject a clock port into each time-using module
Require calls through one declared authority module
open_points.default_guess: Inject a clock port and let each operation perform its specified single read.

open_points.subject: elapsed-clock read count
open_points.text: the elapsed clock gives a duration scale: one reading per request of a clock that cannot move backwards, in seconds as a float, the same value `time.monotonic()` gives. It measures the viewer-entry rate-limit window of A25 only
open_points.question: Does “one reading per request” mean every HTTP request, or only every viewer-entry request to which the rate limiter applies?
options: Read the elapsed clock once for every HTTP request
Read it once only for each viewer-entry request
Read it once for every rate-limited request if more routes become limited
open_points.default_guess: Read it once only for each viewer-entry request.

witness.initial: The service receives an unauthenticated liveness request.
events: The transport layer processes the request.
outcomes: The common request path reads the elapsed clock once even though no rate limit uses it.
No elapsed-clock reading occurs because only viewer entry uses that clock.
witness.observer: A clock-instrumentation test or host-clock adapter.

open_points.subject: security-review formal invariant identity
open_points.text: Every category has an explicit outcome: APPLICABLE resolves to an accepted decision, UNRESOLVED to an open question, and NOT_APPLICABLE carries its project-specific rationale (`SECURITY_REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md`).

Declare that this gate is not a formal invariant
Use an already defined stable ID and name it here
open_points.default_guess: Assign a new stable invariant ID.

open_points.subject: DEP-002 witness binding
open_points.text: DEP-002: the pre-deploy vulnerability check of those pins passes: the deploy step judges every distribution installed in the built image, bound to its content id, against a public advisory snapshot no older than the deploy route's maximum snapshot age, and starts the service only on a passing verdict about that same image no older than its maximum environment age (`max_snapshot_age`, `max_environment_age`: deployment procedure values of the Factory deploy route, rule 3, not portal rules); a listed version, stale, missing or unmatchable data, or another image does not start it [witness: verification:dependency_release_gate_client_portal].
open_points.question: What check will authenticate or otherwise establish that the advisory snapshot came from the required public known-vulnerability source rather than an arbitrary supplied export?
options: Validate a closed public advisory source and its provenance
Cryptographically verify a trusted advisory snapshot
Remove the public-source claim and specify only the accepted input contract
open_points.default_guess: Validate a closed public advisory source and its provenance.
